parsed.summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by short-circuiting the authentication process when either username or password is None. This prevents unnecessary database queries and password hashing.

issues.description: The patch does not handle the case where the username is provided but the password is None. This could potentially lead to unexpected behavior if other authentication backends rely on the password being checked.
The patch introduces a new line that is not aligned with the existing code style, which could affect maintainability.
